articles.expand: The USDCAD found a bottom on Monday, just above Friday's low and key psychological support at 1.4000. The rally extended into Tuesday, initially stalling ahead of the 200-hour moving average before buyers gained enough momentum later in the day to break above it. That move carried the pair toward the July 10 swing low at 1.4116, where the advance began to lose steam. From there, the pair has been on a bit of a roller coaster.
